title: DoorReach
description:
Whether characters reach the door kept where stacked doors are merged,
and step through it, on the paths as the patch leaves them: the paths
over what it hides repaired, the door triangles of the hidden doors
re-attached to the kept one, the doors on the other side leading to it
(ADR 0088).

known.description:
Whether the paths around were read at all; if not, nothing above
is known.

place.description: The worldspace or interior cell asked about.

reached.description: Whether a way leads to it from the rest of the paths.

relinked.description:
How many door triangles of the hidden doors were found and are
re-attached to it.

through.description: Whether characters step through it to the other side.

triangles.description: How many triangles of the paths name it then.

ObjectRef.description:
A placed object, by the plugin that placed it first and its number in
that plugin. Unlike a form ID as the game shows it, this does not
depend on the load order.

localId.description: The object's number in that plugin.
